take: Montreal announced it placed left winger Florian Xhekaj on injured reserve. He was a fourth-line forward averaging 7:36 a night, and the Canadiens have already played four games without him, with Owen Beck taking his spot beside Evans and Dach. Xhekaj had no points in two games this season, and Montreal controlled a smaller share of the 5-on-5 scoring chances when he was on the ice (39 percent) than when he wasn't. Beck is the projected replacement.
